text:
emma: Support -> CS escalation: Orchid Labs trial ingestion is intermittently failing during a large seed. Support reports mix of 429s and 504s. AE flagged renewal at-risk; demo in ~18h. Need a quick mitigation plan and customer note.

raj: Can you paste the last error lines? Want to confirm if it's rate limit or runner timeouts. :mag:

tonya: logs: `2024-11-02T02:11:02Z WARN rate_limiter tenant=orchid qps=820 limit=600` then `2024-11-02T02:11:40Z ERROR proxy upstream read timeout model-runner-2`. No auth errors.

tonya: Ops options: (1) temporary tenant QPS bump for the ingest window, (2) flip to a higher-throughput route (but embeddings may differ), (3) ask customer to reduce concurrency/batch size. Command to bump: `infra tenant update-qps orchid --qps 1500 --note "trial ingest bump"`

emma: Prefer avoid model switch to keep embeddings consistent for demo. Plan: apply QPS bump + ask customer to throttle to 3 workers and batch_size=12. Tonya, can you apply bump and monitor? I'll prep CS note.

tonya: Applying bump now. ops-bot: TASK-9982 created for orchid qps bump.

tonya: Bump applied at 2100001200. Setting provisional autoscale: model-runner-2 scale when cpu>65% window=90s.

emma: Draft CS message (send in 5m): "Hi Orchid team 2 quick note: we2re seeing intermittent throttling on large imports. For tonight's seed, please reduce parallel workers to 3 and set batch_size to 12. We2ve applied a temporary capacity bump on our side and will confirm when stable. Expect an update in 20 minutes." Thoughts?

raj: Add explicit ETA for resolution: confirm in 20m, target full resolution in 3 hours. Also add renewal-risk tag in CRM.

emma: Sent to customer at 2100001250. Customer ACKed and will throttle. They asked: will this change embeddings?

tonya: Clarify to customer: bump does NOT change model weights; embeddings unchanged unless we switch models. Sending reply.

tonya: Monitoring pulse @2100001390: error rate dropped ~85%, occasional 429s <1/min, CPU peaked then recovered after autoscale step.

emma: Great. AE notified and renewal-risk marked. Action items: (1) ops keep monitors 3h (owner: tonya) (2) CS follow-up recap after demo (owner: emma) (3) infra/PM to evaluate ingest pre-warm and transient qps smoothing (owner: raj).

ops-bot: Incident INC-20241102-61 opened by tonya 2 priority=P1 2 Orchid ingest throttling. PagerDuty notified. https://redwood.incidents/INC-20241102-61

emma: Please include the timeline, customer impact, mitigation, and long-term recommendations in the postmortem. If errors recur reopen the handoff. Closing CS handoff for now. :white_check_mark:
